name: Design Master Solutions
facts: Digital agency in Massachusetts that hand-builds websites, mobile apps and managed hosting for trades and small businesses.
Websites are hand-coded, fast on a phone, built for Google and AI search; a website plan ships in 3 to 7 business days and a full redesign of up to 10 pages in 3 to 4 weeks.
iOS and Android apps from one Flutter codebase plus the backend, published by the company to the App Store, Google Play and the Microsoft Store.
Hosting on servers the company runs and monitors, with daily backups, SSL, business email, domain renewals and WordPress maintenance.
Local SEO: Google Business Profile, a page per service, structured data.
Designs, codes, hosts and supports four software products of its own: Stone Project, Cabinet Project, Belcome and Groundflag.
Selected Massachusetts web clients: Clearwater Custom Pools (Harwich Port), Lewis Bay Builders (West Yarmouth), USA Countertops (Wrentham), Louback Services (Milford).
limits: no construction, printing or hardware supply
